text: G49's readings 10 to 21, stated while reading A17's instantiate window i432_026 (26 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (10) A hope or offer of a peace deal from the target's side, addressed to the room, is talk of terms between the rooms (G18's one offer as the lower range), unlike a member's proposal inside the room (cfb-054: c0338's writer answers c0337 under his own post that his side is nowhere near the logo, beside c0336 from r/reddevils): O-A, DEAL. (11) A request reported made is terms (G18), and advice to talk with the neighbour is a proposal to ask; the line is classed by the request (fivenightsatfreddys-071, c0509 then c0510): O-A, DEAL. (12) A line that shows neither end, as restraint and a placement beside a neighbour with the attack in a post with no code, is counted with one end (edmontonoilers-047): ONE. (13) A post that reports the room's spread as done and as breaking agreements shows the order in its words (bulgaria-058 c0045, in a thread its writer opened to limit the flag to its previous borders); so does a neighbour's post that reports the room's covering and asks for talks (detroitredwings-041 c0208): O-H. (14) A proposal to set up truces in the spread's own post, with no request made, is not terms, so only the spread is shown (fireemblem-049 c0214): ONE; a call for a volunteer to negotiate, or for someone to go and negotiate, is a proposal to ask (canada-024 c0184; gamindustri-059 c0116): NT. (15) A neighbour's offer of space beside its work, with protection for each other, sets a space, so it is terms as G18 reads joint marks (canucks-042 c0070): DEAL; a joint build proposed with no border is P17's (denmark-063 c0101), so that line's first terms is the target's conditional offer, c0103. (16) A member's report of having told a neighbour that each room leaves the other alone is terms held (frankocean-064 c0138): INV; keeping a room as an ally is reading 2's alliance (dota2-067 c0104; calgaryflames-057 c0198, a question naming the alliance): INV. (17) A refusal that says the room should be friendly with the target names no agreement (cloud9-049 c0059), and a design change to fit beside neighbours is a choice inside the room (forsen-025 c0037): NT. (18) A call to reclaim territory that the reply says the original deal gave the neighbour is the room's attack, as G48's readings 21, 30 and 88 read a neighbour there first (gatech-047 c0053, c0054): O-A, INV; retaking a work the other room does not claim stays defence (NewMexico-058, reading 1). (19) A complaint that the other room should have worked out a treaty first contests terms, OTHER (costa_rica-047 c0029), with the coded submission c0018 as the first end, marked R. (20) A slogan that names no other work is not the room's attack (furry-057 c0313, as G48's reading 68): NA. (21) A non-portable line is P-G6 whatever its evidence, and PO only where its concepts show the order; france-048's one concept is after the close, so it is not PO. Draw in this window: bulgaria-058 O-H. A slip to disclose: the quote check for window i432_000 was run with a needless shell assignment in front of it (S=1;), a no-op the rules forbid; the check's output was not affected, and no later command carries one.

G49's readings 22 to 32, stated while reading A17's instantiate window i432_052 (26 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (22) The room's act that a neighbour tells of is the room's act (G48 reading 3), even inside the neighbour's threat, and the room's terms that follow answer it (giivasunner-047 c0090 then c0094; lakers-077 c0207 then c0208): O-A, DEAL. (23) A proposal to members that leaves both works, with no request to the other room, is a choice inside the room (globaloffensive-065 c0649), as is restraint that names a cost and a new site (india-047 c0140): NT. (24) A moderator's post that reports the room's painters covering a neighbour's art and then holds the room to its treaty shows the order in its words (greenlattice-060 c1138), as reading 13: O-H. (25) A call to defend the room's place that the reply says the neighbours held first, and by an understanding, is the room's attack (ireland-039 c0205, c0206), as reading 18; a call to push back neighbours who come for the room's logo, where no one says they were there first, stays defence (heroesofthestorm-049 c0251, drawn): NA. (26) The target's terms backed by its own threat answer the room's attack call, since the threat is the target's and not the room's (homelab-058 c0035): O-A, DEAL; help offered by the target for an end to interference is terms, as G18 read shishamo-008 (leafs-059 c0187): DEAL. (27) Where a post proposing a truce has a writer whose side cannot be read, the line does not show talk between the rooms rather than a member's proposal to ask (indonesia-045 c0104): NT. (28) A coded post above the line's concepts that holds terms before the first coded attack makes the bound's pattern, as G48's reading 24 placed restraint, marked R (lebanon-046, drawn: the submission's c0118 at h+44.82 places a heart under the treaty with Austria before the fight that c0137 names at h+46.21, though c0191 later holds a conquest claim to the treaty in the thread): BOUND. (29) A jest at expansion is not the room's attack, as G48's reading 16 (halo-059 c0331, under c0310's treaty refusal): NA. (30) A sister room's treaty with the target, reported to members, is terms held for the room (konosuba-051 c0044): INV. (31) A neighbour's request reported by a member is terms held (masseffect-052 c0048): INV; a neighbour's invitation to negotiate is DEAL (metroid-060 c0195), while the target's plea to build elsewhere that names no place is P07's (c0189). (32) A call from a writer who addresses the room from outside, promising it fame for joining an attack, is a visitor's (megaman-062 c0058): V. Also in this window: luciomains-055's talk is first shown at h+73.88 (AFTER); madokamagica-047 and israel-059 (drawn) answer posts with no code (ONE); germany-064 is P-G6 and not PO, since its answer names no terms. Draws in this window: heroesofthestorm-049 NA, israel-059 ONE, lebanon-046 BOUND.

G49's readings 33 to 44, stated while reading A17's instantiate window i432_078 (22 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (33) A report of other rooms' agreements not to disturb artwork names no terms between the room and another room; it states a norm (minecraft-043 c0059): NT. (34) A call to push back a neighbour that threatens a contested number is defence of the room's place, as reading 25, even where its edit reports a truce (minnesotavikings-058 c0251, c0252, one item): NA. (35) A post that names the room's past attack on a neighbour as the reason for the settlement it defends shows the order in its words (monsterhunter-057 c0167 and c0168, one item, drawn): O-H. (36) A neighbour's post that reports the room's targeting as going on, despite the neighbour's earlier offers of peace, gives the two at hours that cannot be placed against each other, since the offers may answer an earlier overlap (neopets-055 c0011): J. (37) A proposal to members to ally with the target instead of taking its art is P17's and a proposal with no request made (neu-030 c0018, drawn): NT. (38) A visitor's threat against the room is an attack the room suffers, not the room's attack (npr-055 c0036): NA. (39) A hands-off reciprocity stated with no agreement or talk reported names no terms, as reading 2's friendship (palestine-045 c0038): NT. (40) A neighbour's offer that answers an attack suggestion in a post with no code shows only terms (patriots-065 c0150): ONE. (41) A lone placer's request about the placer's own sign is not P08, as G18's reading of a lone placer (pebble-041 c0025): NT. (42) A call that cites the neighbour's breach of a pact is the attack and talk of terms in one post, as reading 6 (physical_removal-056 c0067): J. (43) Under G48's head 3 with P08 in place of P07, a coded parent or submission that talks terms before the first coded attack makes the bound's pattern, marked R, as reading 28 (philippines-058: the submission's c0183, a neighbour's treaty at h+35.33, before c0187 at h+36.48). Looking back over the reply context of every line in windows i432_000 to i432_052 for the same case, I find one: cfb-054, whose submission's c0317 'We are looking to make peace with /r/FinalFantasy' (h+31.38) comes before c0337's strike (h+46.81). Its row in A17-inst-spec-2.txt is corrected from O-A to BOUND, and its tag from DEAL to R, before any row is built; reading 10 stands as a reading of c0338. (44) The target's offer of help to take another site, in the same post as a plea to be allies, is terms that answer the attack (overwatch-086 c0778): DEAL; a member's direction of the neighbour to the room's chat to settle is DEAL (nbaspurs-063 c0226).
